title: PE-13/PE-14 skipped: band columns break runTotalsMode SQL
body: Phase 5 executor found that adding detailBands to catalogCtx in runTotalsMode() (PE-14) and buildQueryPlan() (PE-13) causes SQL errors. Band columns get projected in SELECT but have no JOIN in the FROM clause. Decision: PE-13 and PE-14 are NOT applied — band columns are only needed in runDetailBandsMode() which builds its own catalogCtx. The design doc's PE amendments were incorrect about these two integration points. This is a deviation from the DD but is technically correct.
